item.title: Gold price falls below $3,700, lowest level since September 2025
item.description: Gold traded just below $3,700 an ounce on Thursday after falling to its lowest level since September 2025, as Fed officials signaled more rate increases.

item.title: Boardmasters 2027 lineup names Chase & Status, Disclosure, Wolf Alice
item.description: Chase & Status, Disclosure and Wolf Alice will headline Boardmasters 2027 in Cornwall, with Dutch DJ Chris Stassy booked as the first Thursday headliner.

item.title: Walmart raises full-year outlook as third-quarter revenue rises 5.2%
item.description: Walmart lifted its fiscal 2027 sales and earnings forecasts after third-quarter revenue rose 5.2% to $188.8 billion and global e-commerce sales grew 17%.

item.title: GTA 6 voice actors named in Rockstar credits led by Rourke and Perez
item.description: Rockstar's official Grand Theft Auto VI credits name Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval and Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos, alongside a wider main cast.

item.title: Anthropic shares open at $111.50 in Nasdaq debut after $83 IPO price
item.description: Anthropic shares opened at $111.50 on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on November 19, 34% above the $83 price set for its 980 million share offering.

item.title: Twitch Hosting is coming back and Clips will grow to five minutes
item.description: Twitch said at TwitchCon San Diego 2026 that a new version of Hosting will begin testing later this year and that it is working to extend Clips to five minutes.

item.title: England drought could last into 2027 without 120% of average rainfall
item.description: The England drought remains serious, and officials say at least 120% of average rainfall is needed over the next five months to avoid it lasting into 2027.

item.title: Zelda Ocarina of Time earns four nominations at The Game Awards
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is nominated for Game of the Year, Best Art Direction, Best Score and Music, and Best Action/Adventure at The Game Awards.

item.title: ARIA Awards 2026 hand Tame Impala seven honors and album of the year
item.description: Tame Impala won seven honors, including Album of the Year for Deadbeat, at the 40th ARIA Awards on Wednesday, November 18.

item.title: Optimizely cyber attack sent malware to visitors of 178 organizations
item.description: Optimizely says it fixed a vulnerability in its Experimentation product after malicious JavaScript reached visitors of 178 organizations, according to researchers.

item.title: Rolls-Royce share buyback of £1.5bn follows reaffirmed 2026 guidance
item.description: Rolls-Royce announced a £1.5bn interim share buyback on 12 November 2026 and reaffirmed its 2026 guidance for underlying operating profit and free cash flow.

item.title: Emergency alert system test set for November 18 across Canada
item.description: Alert Ready will test Canada's emergency alert system on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, on television, radio and compatible LTE or 5G wireless devices.

item.title: Arion Kurtaj pleads guilty to Rockstar hack that leaked GTA 6 footage
item.description: Arion Kurtaj, now 21, pleaded guilty at Woolwich Crown Court on November 16 to the 2022 Rockstar Games breach that leaked GTA 6.

item.title: Grammy nominations 2027 hand Raye 11 nods ahead of Feb. 7 ceremony
item.description: Raye leads the 2027 Grammy nominations with 11, Rosalía follows with nine, and the ceremony airs live on ABC from Los Angeles on February 7, 2027.

item.title: Foo Fighters tour adds two Wembley Stadium nights in September 2027
